LESSON: CREATING SHAPES AND FORMS USING ICT

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: CREATING
Topic 6.1: Creating SHAPES AND FORMS USING ICT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Creating SHAPES AND FORMS USING ICT. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What shape can you b) Display the ability to operate the application(Program) create?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Create shapes using electronic shapes using ICT application electronic gadgets to gadgets for creativity •

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

• Today’s maths focus is Creating SHAPES AND FORMS USING ICT.

• Start with objects you can touch or draw — stones, sticks, bottle tops, or drawings in your book.

• Say the steps aloud as you work so you do not skip a stage.

• Check your answer with a second method or by estimating.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market, count 10 mangoes and put them in 2 groups of 5.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row and write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and receive 5 more, you have 12 shillings.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Solve three short problems about Creating SHAPES AND FORMS USING ICT using drawings.
2. Explain one solution to a partner in your own words.
3. Make up one new word problem set in your county or school.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five practice questions and solve them in your book.
2. Show your working clearly — not only the final answer.
3. Teach a younger learner one idea from this lesson with bottle tops or drawings.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Guide learners to open forms and shapes? for familiarization relevant ICT 2. What shape can you b) Display the ability to operate the application(Program) create? gadgets for creating shapes
2. Guide learners to create 3. How did you operate c) Create shapes using electronic shapes using ICT application electronic gadgets to gadgets for creativity
3. Observe safety on create shapes and d) Appreciate own created shapes the use of ICT devices forms? for fun

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Use objects or drawings when a sum feels hard.
2. Check every answer.
3. Creating SHAPES AND FORMS USING ICT is used in real Kenyan life — market, school, and home.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
